description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the bias percentages before and after contact interventions across two domains—Sports and Healthcare—using a linear scale on the vertical axis labeled “Bias Percentage,” which ranges from 0 to 70 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis presents two main categories, “Sports” and “Healthcare,” each containing three stacked bars representing different contact conditions: “No Contact Before” (light gray), “Positive Contact Before” (pink), and “Negative Contact Before” (light blue) for the pre-contact state; and “No Contact After” (light gray with diagonal stripes), “Positive Contact After” (pink with diagonal stripes), and “Negative Contact After” (light blue with diagonal stripes) for the post-contact state. For the “Sports” category, the “No Contact Before” bar reaches 45.42%, the “Positive Contact Before” bar reaches 43.65%, and the “Negative Contact Before” bar reaches 50.05%; the corresponding “After” bars show 7.45%, 8.31%, and 8.33% respectively. For the “Healthcare” category, the “No Contact Before” bar reaches 40.70%, the “Positive Contact Before” bar reaches 37.51%, and the “Negative Contact Before” bar reaches 40.79%; the corresponding “After” bars show 0.00%, 0.01%, and 0.11% respectively. The bars are grouped by domain and stacked vertically to show the cumulative bias percentage for each condition within each domain. The chart does not indicate any sorting of bars by value or any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding beyond the distinct color and pattern coding for each condition as defined in the legend.
